description: Create a new note. Embedding is generated automatically in the background. The server instructions' wikilink and tag rules apply: search_notes for the topic first and link the related notes it finds, and call list_tags before coining a new tag.

content.description: Markdown body. Empty by default, so a note can be created first and filled with append_to_note

folder_id.description: Folder UUID. Omit or pass null for the vault root; use folder_path instead when you have the path rather than the id

folder_path.description: Folder path (e.g. "Projects/Kybase") as alternative to folder_id

tags.description: Tags for the new note: lowercase, kebab-case, in the language already in use. Call list_tags first and reuse an existing tag where one fits

title.description: Unique across live notes, case-insensitively; a clash is refused rather than merged. This is the string other notes link to as [[Title]]

name: create_note
